characters.title: Frankie · A dangerous man having far too much fun
characters.prompt: Male, 47, Newark, New Jersey. An original larger-than-life crime-game character. Thick chesty baritone, coarse dry gravel and a crooked nasal edge; recognizably human and worn, not digitally distorted. Strong musical North Jersey vowels, short biting consonants. Irresistible roguish warmth and swagger. He savors a beautiful weapon, explodes into high cracked outrage, laughs from the belly, then abruptly becomes dangerously quiet. Highly elastic pitch and tempo; extravagant and occasionally ridiculous, but never a comedy mobster impersonation. Seductive physical presence, messy breath, rough chuckles, impatient interruptions. Act the emotional turns with animated-film intensity. No even-paced narration, radio polish, trailer growl or background music. Close dry studio performance.

characters.title: Eve · Velvet command, spectacular temper
characters.prompt: Female, 34, Black British illusionist from south London. Original flamboyant adult game character. Unusually low, dark contralto with a smoky, dry rasp; rich chest resonance and incisive bright consonants. Educated London phrasing over audible south London roots. Sensual and imperious, never soft background narration. A close teasing purr can suddenly open into a huge ringing stage command; an ugly delighted laugh briefly tears through immaculate diction. Stretch a delicious word, then snap three words rapidly. Broad pitch leaps, dramatic interruptions and extravagant wounded vanity. When genuinely afraid, all the ornament vanishes and her voice becomes small and direct. Human grain, no electronic effects, no ASMR monotone, no smooth audiobook delivery. Clean close studio speech.

characters.title: Leon · Warm thunder with a frayed edge
characters.prompt: Male, 39, Black American maintenance engineer from southeast Texas. Original heightened noir-game character. Broad resonant middle-low voice, honeyed warmth with a sandy frayed edge and a slight forward nasal twang. This is not a deep trailer bass. Southern vowels roll leisurely until indignation pulls the words into a rising, almost musical rant. A big infectious laugh, sensual warmth and joyous appetite for powerful machinery. Distinctive uneven rhythm: patient low start, sudden emphatic upward jump, then a dry muttered afterthought. Expressive, physically present, rough around the edges; credible intelligence and tenderness. Fully act delight, frustration and a quiet return to ordinary life. Never cowboy parody, preacher impersonation, radio voice or evenly paced narration. Dry studio speech.

characters.title: Vivian · A smoky laugh and a very expensive temper
characters.prompt: Female, 29, Mexican American Los Angeles confidence trickster; native Los Angeles English, no imposed Spanish accent. Original adult noir-comedy game character. Low-middle pitch with a coarse smoky bottom, bright nasal sting on emphatic words, and a wonderfully ragged laugh. Sexy through mischievous intimacy and shameless confidence, not perpetual whispering. Fast conspiratorial asides give way to languid appraisal, then a startling high outraged snap. Richly varied pitch, flirtatious power, imperfect breath and comic timing. She appears to enjoy an appalling idea before she has finished saying it. Real vulnerability strips away the musical sales pitch. Exaggerated animated-character range with a human body behind the voice. No polished commercial cheer, flat vocal fry or soothing narration. Close dry recording.

characters.title: Voss · The host who enjoys owning the room
characters.prompt: Male, apparent age 58, American theatrical casino kingpin. An original character. Rich rounded bass-baritone with a fine sandpaper burr, heavy chest resonance and bright smiling upper overtones. Cultivated mid-Atlantic American articulation. Opulent seductive hospitality: he savors names, relishes a ceremonial phrase, then unexpectedly clips the next sentence short. His expansive almost operatic delight can turn into a tiny cold intimate threat without a generic sinister growl. Dry chuckles, strategic breath, unsettling warmth and explosive wounded vanity when refused. Large animated-villain performance range while sounding physically human and intelligent. Never a broadcast announcer, smooth audiobook narrator, frail aristocrat or celebrity imitation. Close clean dry studio speech, no PA filter, no music.

lines.delivery: Lavish hospitality grows joyfully extravagant, then lands as a quiet personal demand. Audition rhetoric, not new prop commitments.

characters.title: Marlowe · A ruined tenor with immaculate manners
characters.prompt: Male, appears 63, from near Leeds in northern England. Original casino bartender character. A narrow, weather-beaten middle-register tenor, papery rasp and a faint reedy whistle in breath; lower notes unexpectedly warm and intimate. Clearly distinct from deep gangster voices. Soft Yorkshire vowels, clipped practical consonants, wonderfully uneven dry timing. Courteous words carry impudent private delight. Usually speaks close and plain, but a tiny affront can produce a sudden piercing bark before manners return. A dusty almost involuntary chuckle, lived-in wit and surprising emotional bite. Heightened character acting, never a sleepy old narrator, whisper-only voice or generic butler. A shameful admission loses the clever timing. No actor imitation or audio effects. Dry clean studio speech.
